title: Phase A PUT inserts a new stage_states version; only locked is guarded
summary: PUT /api/projects/:id/stages/:n always INSERTs version+1 on the active branch. Requested status defaults to draft; the only guard coerces draft to locked when the latest row is locked. Rows are never updated in place.
notes: Test coverage for the regression guard is WD-IMPL-INVALIDATE-0001 (wave1, stageStates.ts:211-222); no dedicated test name re-verified.
trigger: PUT /api/projects/:id/stages/:n from autosave or manual save (stageStateService.saveStageState)
precondition: project owned by user; active_branch_id set; stage 1..12; content is object; status in draft|locked|invalidated|outdated|skipped if given
side_effects: INSERT stage_states row; INSERT style_capsule_applications when styleCapsuleMetadata present; UPDATE projects.updated_at
preserves: latest locked status (draft request coerced to locked); inherited_from_stage_id link; prior versions
ui_signal: autosave failure toast; Saving/All changes saved label in Stage 1 and others

title: Save over outdated or skipped row silently becomes draft
summary: The status guard in PUT only checks for locked. Any save with no explicit status over an outdated or skipped latest row writes a draft row, which erases the outdated marker and the skipped status.
notes: Client sends status draft explicitly (stageStateService.ts:113 default). Runtime effect on a live outdated row was not executed; code path is unconditional.
trigger: any PUT /stages/:n with status absent or draft while latest status is outdated or skipped (autosave on mount included)
precondition: latest row status outdated or skipped
side_effects: new draft row with submitted content, origin NULL
invalidates: the outdated marker on this stage (its downstream markers remain)
ui_signal: OUTDATED badge disappears on next load; skipped placeholder disappears

title: Phase A lock copies latest content regardless of latest status
summary: POST /stages/:n/lock inserts a locked row copying content and regeneration_guidance from the latest row, whatever its status. Predecessor must be locked or skipped. This is the only Phase A re-lock path for an outdated stage.
notes: Route does not check the current status of stage n (draft, outdated, or locked all accepted). origin is not copied (NULL).
trigger: ProjectView.handleStageComplete / stage component stageStateService.lockStage (Approve and Continue, Stage 4 approve, Stage 5 finalize)
precondition: latest row exists; stage 1 or latest(n-1) status in locked|skipped; DB trigger enforces same for any locked insert
side_effects: INSERT stage_states locked, version+1, inherited_from = latest row
preserves: content and regeneration_guidance copied; prior versions
ui_signal: toast Stage n completed and locked; timeline locked node

title: Phase A skip for stages 2 to 4
summary: POST /stages/:n/skip inserts a skipped row with origin skipped and empty content for stages 2, 3 and 4 when the predecessor is locked or skipped and the current row is not locked. Outdated or draft current rows are allowed.
notes: Reachability: no UI caller of stageStateService.skipStage found in this wave (wave1 said the same). Streamline commit performs the same transition in SQL.
trigger: POST /stages/:n/skip (n in 2,3,4) - no UI caller found; streamline commit 'skip' transition is the live path
precondition: n in 2..4; latest(n-1) locked|skipped; latest(n) not locked
side_effects: INSERT skipped row, origin skipped, content {}, regeneration_guidance empty; projects.updated_at bump

title: Phase A unlock assessment returns 409 without writing
summary: POST /stages/:n/unlock with confirm false (or absent) computes downstream stages in 2..5 whose latest status is locked or outdated and returns 409 with details. Requires the target latest status to be locked or skipped; outdated or draft targets get 400.
notes: Functional on the server. The client does not display the response (see H-FACT-01). Test coverage for this route not found in this wave.
trigger: ProjectView.handlePhaseAUnlock via LockedStageHeader Unlock and Edit

title: Phase A unlock confirm inserts draft and outdated copies
summary: With confirm true, the target stage gets a draft row copying content, and every downstream stage whose latest is locked or outdated gets an outdated copy. Skipped downstream rows are untouched. Scene (Phase B) data is not touched. Downstream inserts are not error-checked.
notes: Reachable in practice only via auto-confirm (H-FACT-01) or Write this myself (skipped target, H-STATE-09). Frontend local state mirrors the cascade only for display. Test coverage: streamlineSkip.test.ts covers lock and skip only, not the unlock cascade.
side_effects: INSERT draft for n (origin NULL, inherited_from = prior row); INSERT outdated for each downstream locked|outdated stage (content copied); projects.updated_at bump
invalidates: downstream locked stages in 2..5 become outdated
preserves: content of all stages; skipped downstream rows; all Phase B scene rows and artifacts
ui_signal: toast Stage n unlocked for editing; OUTDATED badge downstream on reload

title: Streamline commit applies per-stage transitions in SQL
summary: streamline_commit (via streamline_commit_atomic) iterates stage keys 1..5 ascending: skip (2-4), locked (copy latest content), or object (any status with content). All are append-only INSERTs. Object transitions have no check of the existing lock state.
notes: streamlineCommit.test.ts referenced by wave1 (forwards project configuration and the Stage 1 draft). Not re-run.
precondition: stage_transitions object; skip only 2..4; skip and locked require predecessor locked|skipped; object with status locked requires predecessor locked|skipped
side_effects: projects config updated via COALESCE; Stage 1 draft INSERT (wrapper); one INSERT per transition; FOR UPDATE lock on stage 1..5 rows
ui_signal: PhaseTimeline SKIPPED and IMPORTED badges; navigation to target stage

title: Streamline backfill converts skipped stage to locked ai-generated
summary: POST /streamline/backfill/:n inserts version+1 with status locked and origin ai-generated, inherited_from the skipped row. Requires latest skipped and predecessor locked or skipped.
notes: wave1-unverified in this wave; route body not re-read.
precondition: latest skipped; stage 4 locked with formattedScript; predecessor locked|skipped (wave1)
side_effects: INSERT locked row, origin ai-generated; projects.updated_at

title: Phase A mount autosave writes a draft row after load
summary: useStageState's autosave effect fires once after the load completes (content set and isLoading false in the same tick), so opening Stage 2, 3 or 5 writes a draft row with the loaded content and origin NULL. Stage 1 disables autosave to avoid a race with lock.
notes: Inferred from hook logic; runtime not executed. A locked row stays locked (guard); an outdated row becomes draft.
trigger: Phase A stage mount with autoSave true and a real projectId
precondition: projectId not new; stage component mounted
side_effects: INSERT stage_states draft (origin NULL) with loaded content
invalidates: outdated marker on the stage (when outdated)
ui_signal: Auto-save failed toast on error only

title: Stage 4 open and approve write stage 4 versions
summary: Opening Stage 4 sets the TipTap editor content, which emits an update (TipTap 3.15.3 setContent default emitUpdate true) and schedules a 2 s debounced PUT draft. Approve persists scenes then locks stage 4 with two separate requests; the debounce timer is not cancelled on approve.
notes: Timing-dependent for the post-approve write. Stage 4 autosave prop is false; custom debounce is the only save path.
trigger: Stage 4 mount with content; each keystroke; Approve Script click
side_effects: PUT stage 4 draft (new version each time); scenes persisted then stage 4 lock inserted
preserves: locked status on draft PUT (guard); content replaced by editor content
ui_signal: Saving or Saved label; Master Script approved toast

title: Scene stage lock writes locked entry into stage_locks
summary: POST /scenes/:s/stage-locks/:n/lock for n in 7..12 writes {status locked, locked_at} into scenes.stage_locks. Predecessor must be locked (outdated blocks). Current status of n is not checked. Stage 7 also sets shot_list_locked_at.
notes: Column scenes.stage_locks exists only via a manual quickies script (H-FACT-05). No backend predecessor check against stage_locks of 7 for stage 8 beyond locked test.
trigger: ProjectView.handleSceneStageComplete; useSceneStageLock.lockStage; Stage 7 hook after shots/lock
precondition: project owned; scene in active branch; n=7 or stage_locks[n-1].status locked
side_effects: UPDATE scenes stage_locks and updated_at; stage 7 sets shot_list_locked_at=now (trigger sets status shot_list_ready)

title: Scene unlock assessment and confirm (stages 7..12)
summary: Scene unlock with confirm false returns 409 impact (downstream locked|outdated, frames count, videos count with missing table). Confirm sets the stage to draft, downstream locked|outdated to outdated, and clears shot_list_locked_at for stage 7.
notes: Dialog works (client unwraps details). videosAffected always 0 (missing table). Frame and video counts shown are frames only. Test coverage: no test found for stage-locks unlock; shotLocking4_5_task_11.test.ts asserts only 401 and skipped placeholders.
trigger: UnlockWarningDialog flow in Stage 7/8/9/10/11/12 headers (useSceneStageLock.unlockStage then confirmUnlock)
precondition: stage locked or outdated (draft or missing gives 400)
side_effects: confirm: stage_locks[n]=draft; downstream locked|outdated -> outdated; stage 7 clears shot_list_locked_at
ui_signal: dialog counts; header switches to editable; outdated downstream badge

title: Scene stage relock from outdated
summary: POST relock requires the stage to be exactly outdated and predecessor locked. It writes locked with new locked_at and sets shot_list_locked_at for stage 7. No content change.
notes: Stage 7 relock sets shot_list_locked_at without the shots validation used by shots/lock.
precondition: status outdated; stage 7 or predecessor locked
preserves: all other stage entries and artifacts

title: Stage 7 shot list lock via shots/lock (validated, race-guarded)
summary: POST shots/lock validates the shot list (errors block, warnings need force), then sets shot_list_locked_at, stage_locks['7'] locked, and updated_at with an UPDATE guarded by shot_list_locked_at IS NULL. Already-locked scenes return success with no write.
notes: stage_locks is read at the start and written without a guard on stage_locks, so a concurrent stage_locks write can be overwritten. Stage 7 UI then calls stage-locks/7/lock (second write). Test coverage: shotLocking4_5_task_11.test.ts asserts only 401 and skipped placeholders for shots/lock.
trigger: Stage 7 Lock Shot List button (lockShotList false or force true)
precondition: project owned; scene on active branch; not already locked; no validation errors; warnings only with force
side_effects: UPDATE scenes shot_list_locked_at, updated_at, stage_locks['7']; trigger sets status shot_list_ready
preserves: shots, frames, prompts, assignments, stages 8-12 entries
ui_signal: Stage 7 footer hidden; LockedStageHeader; Shot list locked toast

title: Shot list unlock route with downstream attempt that is partly ineffective
summary: POST shots/unlock requires shot_list_locked_at non-null. When scene status is frames_locked or video_complete it needs confirm. With confirm it attempts invalidation of frames and videos, then sets stage_locks[7] draft, 8..12 locked|outdated to outdated, and clears shot_list_locked_at.
notes: Reachability: frames_locked is never written (H-FACT-04), so the downstream branch is only reached when scene status is video_complete. Frontend caller present in shotService.ts:441-460. Test asserts stage_locks only, not frames invalidation.
precondition: shot_list_locked_at non-null; if downstream work then confirm required
side_effects: frames/videos status write attempts (fail); invalidation_logs insert attempt (table absent); stage_locks update; shot_list_locked_at null; trigger may revert status only from shot_list_ready
preserves: shot rows, frames, prompts, assignments, camera directions, location views

title: Shot assignment mutation and split mark stage 9-12 outdated (fire-and-forget)
summary: Successful create, update, delete, bulk delete of shot-asset assignments and shot split call invalidateStage9AndDownstream, which sets each locked stage 9..12 entry to outdated. The call is not awaited before the response.
notes: Read-modify-write on stage_locks without guard. Merge and single delete do not call it (H-INV-11).
trigger: POST/PUT/DELETE shot-assignments, DELETE all, shot split success
preserves: all rows, prompts, frames, videos, assignments
ui_signal: outdated badge on next load of that stage

title: scenes.status is synced by trigger to shot_list_locked_at null-ness
summary: BEFORE UPDATE trigger on scenes sets status shot_list_ready when shot_list_locked_at goes null to non-null, and draft when it goes non-null to null only if the old status was shot_list_ready. Other statuses are left unchanged.
notes: Trigger only on UPDATE; direct INSERTs of scenes bypass it.
trigger: any UPDATE on scenes that changes shot_list_locked_at null-ness
precondition: OLD and NEW shot_list_locked_at differ in null-ness
preserves: video_complete and any non-shot_list_ready status on unlock

title: frames.status lifecycle across generation, approval and rejection
summary: Frames move pending to generating at job start, to generated on job success (written by ImageGenerationService by shot and type, or by the status endpoint), to approved or rejected by explicit routes, and back to generating on regenerate. Job failure does not update the frame unless the unused status endpoint runs.
notes: Full diagram in the .md section 4.5. Transitions F1..F12 enumerated there.
trigger: startFrameGeneration; job success; job failure; approve/reject; select-generation; regenerate; createImageJob throw
side_effects: image_url, storage_path, generated_at, prompt_snapshot, current_job_id, generation_count, approved_at, total_cost_credits (via status endpoint, repeatedly)
invalidates: prior image on success; incoming frame_links on regenerate, upload, select-generation
preserves: image_url on failure; prior jobs; generated_from_frame_id
ui_signal: Pending, Generating, Ready, Rejected badges; Stage 10 polls 2 s while generating

title: frame_links lifecycle (match and reference)
summary: frame_links rows connect a source frame to a target frame with link_type match (reactive copy) or reference (one-shot). One link per target. Created by copy, batch copy, add-as-reference; deleted by regenerate, upload, select-generation, DELETE route and pull-ref replacement.
notes: Deletion on regenerate happens before generation starts, and propagation runs right after the job is queued (H-INV-17).
trigger: copy-frame, batch-link-copy, add-frame-as-reference, DELETE frame-links, regenerate, upload, select-generation
precondition: both frames exist; source image non-null for propagation
side_effects: link rows inserted or deleted; target image overwritten on propagation; target prompt_snapshot set
invalidates: prior match or reference link on the target
preserves: reference links on propagation; links on other targets
ui_signal: Push Match TO, Pull Match FROM, Ref Source badges

title: video_generation_jobs status machine
summary: Executor picks the oldest queued job, moves it through processing, generating and uploading to completed. Any throw sends the job back to queued while attempt_count below max_retries (3), otherwise to failed. No recovery exists for jobs left in a non-queued active state after a process restart.
notes: In-process isProcessing flag only. Runtime behaviour UNKNOWN.
trigger: confirm-render triggers processQueuedJobs (fire and forget) and retry triggers processing
side_effects: processing_started_at, attempt_count += 1, provider calls, storage upload, video_url, storage_path, actual_cost, provider ids, error_message, error_code, completed_at
preserves: prompt and frame URL snapshots taken at queue time
ui_signal: Stage 12 status badges and 3 s polling

title: Manual video job retry resets status but not attempt_count
summary: retryJob requires status failed, sets queued and nulls error, URL, provider and timing fields, keeps attempt_count, and triggers processing. The next attempt therefore starts at the old count.
notes: With max_retries 3, a job that failed after 3 attempts gets one attempt on retry.
side_effects: status queued; error and output fields nulled; triggerJobProcessing
ui_signal: toast Job queued for retry; polling resumes

title: scenes.status set to video_complete when all historical jobs complete
summary: After each job completes or fails, checkAndUpdateSceneStatus loads every video job for the scene (no filter) and sets scenes.status to video_complete only when all of them are completed. Partial or failed sets leave status unchanged.
notes: video_complete is never reverted by code; unlock leaves it. Once any historical job is failed, the scene cannot reach video_complete until that job completes via retry.
trigger: VideoJobExecutor after completion or final failure
precondition: all scene jobs completed for video_complete
ui_signal: Script Hub scene status badge; render status batch

title: project_assets flags: locked, deferred, style_outdated
summary: locked gates text edits, delete, merge, split and sync (set by lock-all, POST lock, and Stage 8 manual create). deferred removes assets from the gate and lock-all. style_outdated is advisory, set by mark-style-outdated and cleared by successful master job or clear-all. No route clears locked.
notes: deferred writers not re-verified (wave1-unverified). Gate enforcement of locked on PUT or DELETE checked only by wave1.
trigger: lock-all, POST lock, Stage 8 create, mark-style-outdated, clear-all, master job success
precondition: lock POST needs image_key_url; lock-all needs gate pass
side_effects: flag writes; image_key_url nulled by clear-all; style_outdated set
preserves: image, attempts, angle variants, location views (until cleared)

title: Attempt selection mirrors into image_key_url for scene instances and project assets
summary: Exactly one attempt per instance or asset is is_selected (partial unique index). Select, upload, generation completion and use-master deselect the old attempt, select the new one, and copy its URL to image_key_url. The select route writes image_key_url in a separate statement.
notes: Partial failure between the two writes can leave them inconsistent (code permits). Caps listed in H-INV-24.
trigger: select attempt; generation completion; upload; use-master; backfill
precondition: attempt belongs to instance or asset
side_effects: previous selection cleared; new selection set; image_key_url set; modification_count incremented (scene instances)
invalidates: reference chain entries that used the prior selected URL (not rewritten)

title: Transformation event confirm is one-way
summary: Confirm sets confirmed=true and confirmed_at. The update path never writes confirmed and no un-confirm route exists. Confirmed events remain editable through PUT. Only confirmed events affect resolution and inheritance.
notes: Edits to a confirmed event are not blocked by any lock. transformationEvents.test.ts (320-350) covers resolution filtering of unconfirmed events, not the one-way confirm behaviour.
preserves: post_description, post image, all other fields
ui_signal: green card, Confirmed label, post image section

title: Video render confirm inserts jobs and deducts credits in separate steps
summary: confirmAndQueueRender checks sufficient credits, inserts one video job per shot, deducts the scene total from the user balance after insertion, then triggers processing. Prior jobs are not removed and there is no duplicate-render guard.
notes: Credit read-modify-write; no ledger, no refund path (wave1). A deduction throw leaves queued jobs and does not trigger processing.
side_effects: video_generation_jobs INSERT per shot; user_credits balance reduced; triggerJobProcessing
preserves: all earlier jobs for the scene
ui_signal: next Stage 11 load shows new balance (checkout query not invalidated)

title: Phase A unlock marks locked or outdated downstream stages outdated
summary: Confirmed Phase A unlock of stage n outdates every downstream stage in 2..5 whose latest status is locked or outdated. Nothing else is invalidated: no scene, shot, frame, prompt, video or asset row changes.
notes: Phase B locks are not touched by Phase A unlock (no code references scenes in the route).
ui_signal: OUTDATED badge downstream (after reload or local state)

title: Phase A save, lock and commit never invalidate downstream stages
summary: Only unlock writes outdated marks in Phase A. PUT, lock, skip and streamline commit write rows for one stage and leave downstream rows as they are, so a downstream locked stage stays locked after an upstream change.
notes: Stage 1 config PUT (projects.ts:640-807) also does not touch stage_states.
trigger: any Phase A write other than unlock

title: Locked Stage 2 and 3 bodies remain editable with no unlock
summary: Stage 2 and Stage 3 swap only the header to LockedStageHeader when locked. The editor bodies (beat list, treatment editor) are not disabled by lock state, so edits write new locked rows through the autosave path.
notes: Only the Stage 2 use of the flag at line 90 and 437 found in the Stage 2 body; Stage 3 beat disabled prop uses isRegenerating or isGenerating only.
trigger: user edits in a locked Stage 2 or 3
side_effects: autosave PUT draft becomes locked row with new content

title: Streamline commit replaces stage content with no lock or downstream check
summary: The object-transition branch of streamline_commit inserts the submitted content for any stage 1..5 with no check of the existing latest status. Locked content can be superseded without unlock, and nothing downstream is marked.
notes: Reachability depends on whether the Streamline review screen can be entered for a project whose stages are locked (H-FACT-18, UNKNOWN). Predecessor check still applies to locked objects.
trigger: Streamline confirm with stage_transitions object for stages 1..5
precondition: stage 1..5 object; locked object requires predecessor locked|skipped
side_effects: new row (version+1) for each object transition; Stage 1 draft row
preserves: prior versions; Stage 5+ artifacts are not touched and become stale relative to new content
ui_signal: navigation to target stage; PhaseTimeline badges

title: Stage 4 approve is non-atomic and a pending save can rewrite the locked stage
summary: Approve persists scenes and then locks stage 4 in separate calls. The debounced Stage 4 PUT draft timer is not cancelled on approve, so a write landing after the lock stores new content under locked status (guard keeps locked).
notes: Timing-dependent; no test. Stage 4 lock copies the latest persisted row, which can be older than the editor content if the debounce has not fired.
trigger: Approve Script click within 2 s of an edit
side_effects: scenes rewritten (matched rows updated, unmatched deleted); stage 4 locked row; possible later draft PUT with locked status
invalidates: downstream scene work by re-pointing (see H-INV-13)

title: Scene unlock (Phase B) cascades to outdated only and deletes nothing
summary: Confirmed scene stage unlock sets the stage to draft and marks downstream locked or outdated stages outdated. Frames, videos, prompts, shots, assignments and camera directions are not changed by the route.
notes: Counts displayed in the dialog come from frames (live) and videos (missing table, always 0). shotLocking4_5_task_11.test.ts asserts only 401 and skipped placeholders.

title: Stage 7 validation gate exists only on shots/lock; generic stage-lock route has none
summary: Shot validation (errors and warnings) runs only inside POST shots/lock. POST stage-locks/7/lock performs no shot validation and writes the same lock state, and Stage 7 calls both in sequence after a successful shots/lock.
notes: Generic route reachable directly; the UI calls it only after validation succeeded, so no bypass is reached from the shipped UI path found in this wave.
precondition: predecessor rule for stage 7 is none
preserves: shots that fail validation remain unlocked only if called through shots/lock

title: Downstream artifact invalidation in shots/unlock silently fails
summary: shots/unlock attempts to set frames and videos status to invalidated. The frames write violates the frames.status CHECK, and the videos table does not exist. Errors are not checked, so frames and videos are unchanged while the response reports counts.
notes: Response body reports framesAffected and videosAffected counts from SELECTs; videos count is always 0 because the table does not exist.
trigger: shots/unlock confirm when scene status is frames_locked or video_complete
side_effects: none effective on frames or videos; invalidation_logs insert attempt
invalidates: intended: frames and videos; effective: none

title: Scene unlock impact counts videos from a missing table
summary: The impact assessment for stage-locks unlock counts videos through the videos table, which no migration creates, so videosAffected and the estimated video cost are always 0 in the dialog.
notes: Video count reads shown in UI come from this route. Storage bucket named videos exists separately (Veo3Provider.ts:338-354).

title: Assignment changes and split mark stages 9-12 outdated; merge and delete do not
summary: Only shot-assignment mutations and shot split call the stage 9..12 outdating helper. Shot merge and single-shot delete remove shot rows without updating stage_locks, even though the rows and their cascades change Stage 9 to 12 content.
notes: Helper is fire-and-forget. Split route does not await it.

title: Shot mutation routes are not gated by the Stage 7 shot-list lock
summary: PUT shot content, prompt PUT, location PUT, camera-direction PUT, reorder, extract, split and merge do not read shot_list_locked_at or stage_locks before writing. Lock state is UI-only for these routes.
notes: Only shots/lock and shots/unlock read shot_list_locked_at in that route range.
ui_signal: disabled editor controls in Stage 7 while locked (UI)

title: Shot row delete cascades to frames, jobs, transformation events and assignments
summary: Deleting a shot row removes its frames (and frame_links via frames), image and video jobs, transformation events where it is the trigger shot, shot-asset assignments and location match events. completion_shot_id is set to null, and shot order is not compacted.
notes: Video files in storage are not removed by the cascade (no storage delete on this path).
trigger: DELETE shot; merge deletes two shot rows
preserves: scene, other shots, location views, stage_locks

title: PUT /scenes re-persist deletes unmatched scenes and their dependents; delete errors ignored
summary: Stage 4 approve and streamline sync send the full scene list. Existing scenes are matched by slug and number then number alone. Unmatched existing scenes are deleted (cascading to shots, frames, jobs, instances, events), the delete error is ignored, and matched rows keep their ids, lock state and status.
notes: sceneIdStability.test.ts (wave1 name) not found under backend/src/tests; positional matching behaviour not test-verified. Renumbering can attach old dependents to a different scene.
side_effects: DELETE unmatched scenes; UPDATE matched; INSERT new as draft
invalidates: all dependents of deleted scenes; dependents of matched scenes stay attached to the matched id
preserves: matched scene id, status, stage_locks, shot_list_locked_at, is_deferred

title: stage_locks and shot_list_locked_at are read-modify-write with no version guard
summary: Scene stage lock and unlock routes, shots lock/unlock and the assignment helper each read the full stage_locks map, mutate it and write it back. Concurrent writers can lose updates. shot_list_locked_at update is guarded by IS NULL only for the shot-list lock.
notes: No runtime concurrency test found. Lost update is a code-level possibility only.
side_effects: possible overwrite of another writer's entry

title: Shot content and prompt edits invalidate no frames, videos or links
summary: PUT of shot content fields and PUT of prompts (frame, video, end frame, start continuity) update only the shots row (plus location fields for setting changes and text version write-back). Frames, frame_links, video jobs and prompt snapshots are not marked or compared.
notes: Frontend shows Unsaved changes only.
trigger: PUT shot; PUT prompts; version select write-back
side_effects: shots row updated_at and column values
preserves: frames, frame_links, video jobs, prompt_snapshot values

title: Generate-prompts overwrites prompt and reference columns but preserves frames and links
summary: Stage 9 generate-prompts overwrites the frame and video prompts, requires_end_frame, compatible models, reference order columns, end reference order, AI start continuity and prompts_generated_at for each successful shot. It writes text_field_versions rows and leaves frames, frame_links and shot assignments alone.
notes: wave1-unverified in detail; route and service range referenced but not re-read in full this wave.
side_effects: prompt columns overwritten; text_field_versions INSERT; start_continuity none for single-shot regeneration
invalidates: user reference replacements and end reference overrides when assignments are absent
preserves: frames, frame_links, shot_asset_assignments, selected continuity base (column not written)
ui_signal: Stage 9 Generated timestamp; Edited badge cleared on reload

title: Frame regenerate deletes incoming links and propagates the pre-regeneration image
summary: POST frames/:id/regenerate deletes incoming frame_links for the frame, queues a new image job asynchronously, then calls propagateFrameLinks immediately. The job has not finished, so match targets receive the source image as it was before regeneration, and no later propagation occurs.
notes: Code-derived from the non-awaited background job call. Runtime timing not executed.
precondition: frame exists; source image url may be null (propagation then skipped)
side_effects: target frame images overwritten with old source image; target prompt_snapshot set
ui_signal: target frames show old image until manual change

title: Frame job failure leaves the frame in generating with no UI-driven recovery
summary: When an image job fails, only the job row and any angle variant are updated. The frame status moves to rejected only through GET frames/:id/status, which no UI code calls. Stage 10 keeps polling while any frame is generating.
notes: pollUntilComplete has no callers in src. Runtime UNKNOWN whether the endpoint is hit by other clients.
ui_signal: Generating spinner persists; 2 s refetch indefinitely

title: Select-generation clears approval, breaks incoming links, then propagates after the update
summary: PUT select-generation sets current_job_id, image_url, prompt_snapshot and status generated, clears approved_at, deletes incoming frame_links for the frame, and runs propagateFrameLinks after the update, so match targets receive the newly selected image.
notes: Ordering is correct here, unlike regenerate (H-INV-17).
precondition: job status completed and belongs to frame
side_effects: frame update; target image overwrite via propagation
ui_signal: FramePanel badge; confirm dialog for match targets

title: Frame approve has no precondition on image, status or scene
summary: PUT approve sets status approved and approved_at for the frame id with no check that the frame has an image, is generated, or belongs to the scene in the path. Reject has the same shape.
notes: Only the project ownership check runs before approveFrame.

title: Asset and extraction edits do not propagate into scene instances
summary: Project asset description and name edits, and global sync, do not update scene_asset_instances copies. Instances keep the values copied at creation, and effective_description is recomputed only on instance PUT or create.
notes: wave1-unverified for global sync and inheritance details.
trigger: project asset edit; global sync; prior instance edit
ui_signal: values differ from project asset until manual change

title: Project asset and scene instance deletes cascade to attempts, assignments and transformation events
summary: Deleting a project asset cascades to its attempts, angle variants, location views and scene instances, which cascade to attempts, shot-asset assignments and transformation events. Shot location references are set null. Storage objects are not removed by the cascade.
notes: Storage removal occurs only in attempt cap, DELETE generation and some explicit routes (wave1 claims view delete removes storage object).
trigger: DELETE project asset; DELETE scene instance
invalidates: assignments and transformation events for the instance; shot location references

title: text_field_versions has no foreign key to its entity and is orphaned on delete
summary: text_field_versions stores polymorphic entity_id with no FK, so deleting a shot or scene instance leaves its version rows behind. Its RLS policy is FOR ALL USING (true), so row visibility is not restricted by the table policy.
notes: Orphan cleanup path not found. Whether RLS applies depends on the role used by the backend client (UNKNOWN from code alone).

title: Attempt and version caps delete the oldest non-selected entry
summary: Caps are 8 for scene asset attempts, 4 for project asset attempts and 8 for text field versions. Creating beyond the cap deletes the oldest non-selected row. Attempt caps also remove the storage object; text versions have no storage.
notes: Selected row is never deleted by the cap. textFieldVersionService.test.ts:79 asserts the constant only, not the cap deletion.
trigger: any insert that would exceed the cap
side_effects: row delete; storage remove for attempts
ui_signal: carousel or arrows lose the oldest item

title: project_assets.locked has no clearing route and blocks text, delete, merge and split
summary: Once true, locked is only changed by writers that set it to true; no route sets it false. The flag is set by lock-all, POST lock and Stage 8 manual asset creation. Locked assets are excluded from gate changes made through the blocked routes.
notes: Blocking behaviour on PUT, DELETE, merge, split is wave1-unverified (not re-read in this wave). The clone insert default false is not a clearing write.
precondition: lock POST needs image; lock-all needs gate
preserves: image, attempts, angle variants, location views

title: Style change does not unlock stage 5 or regenerate asset images; style_outdated is advisory
summary: Mark-style-outdated sets style_outdated on imaged assets without changing image_key_url. Clear-all nulls image_key_url. Neither route unlocks Stage 5 or changes asset capsule ids, and no gate reads style_outdated.
notes: Only reader of style_outdated is the badge at Stage5Assets.tsx:1153.
trigger: Change Style then Mark Outdated or Clear All Images
side_effects: style_outdated true or image_key_url null; client local state cleared
invalidates: nothing in the DB beyond the flag or image
preserves: asset descriptions, capsule ids, scene instance images, attempts

title: Video jobs are not invalidated by upstream change and keep queue-time snapshots
summary: No code path marks or deletes video_generation_jobs when frames, prompts, assignments or stage locks change. Prompt and frame URL snapshots are stored at queue time, so completed or queued jobs keep the inputs they were created with.
notes: grep of video_generation_jobs across backend shows writers only in checkout, videoGenerationService, VideoJobExecutor and migration 021 (wave1).

title: Transformation confirm is irreversible and confirmed events remain editable
summary: No route clears confirmed. PUT on a confirmed event accepts field changes, so confirmed content can change after resolution has used it. Inherited copies made earlier are not rewritten.
notes: Inheritance copies description, tags and image at inheritance time (wave1).

title: Video render confirm does not check or remove earlier jobs for the scene
summary: confirm-render appends jobs for every shot in the scene without deleting or superseding existing jobs for that scene, and without checking whether jobs are already queued or running.
notes: Duplicate-render guard absent in service code path read this wave.

title: Scene video_complete is unreachable while any historical job for the scene is failed
summary: checkAndUpdateSceneStatus requires every job for the scene (all renders, all time) to be completed. A failed job from any earlier render blocks the scene from video_complete until that job is retried to completion.
notes: Runtime UNKNOWN; code-level reading only.
trigger: any job completion or final failure
precondition: at least one historical failed job
ui_signal: scene does not show Video complete

title: Video retry gets one attempt after exhausting the retry budget
summary: Retry does not reset attempt_count. A job that reached attempt_count 3 and failed gets queued; its next processing sets attempt_count to 4, and the failure path then marks it failed on the first retry failure.
notes: Arithmetic from code; not run. Wave1 V10 said attempt_count kept (consistent).
ui_signal: toast; the job fails again quickly

title: Video jobs stuck in active states after a process restart have no recovery path
summary: Jobs in processing, generating or uploading are not picked up by the executor, which selects only queued jobs, and no sweep or reset of these statuses was found. Their state persists until a database change.
notes: Grep for processing and generating writers shows only executor and updateJobStatus. isProcessing is in-memory.
ui_signal: rendering status stays active; 3 s polling continues

title: Credits are deducted after job insertion without a transaction or ledger
summary: Jobs are inserted before deductCredits runs. A deduction failure leaves the jobs queued while the user sees an error, and processing is not triggered by that call. No refund or ledger path exists.
notes: Ledger absence and refund absence are from grep (wave1). Runtime UNKNOWN.

title: Scene status trigger reverts only from shot_list_ready
summary: On shot-list unlock the DB trigger changes status to draft only if the old status was shot_list_ready. frames_locked and video_complete are preserved, so the scene keeps those labels while stage_locks[7] reads draft.
notes: Inconsistency between status and stage_locks is code-derived.

title: Project delete cascades DB rows only; storage objects are not removed
summary: DELETE /api/projects/:id deletes the project row and relies on FK cascades for children. No storage removal call is made in the route, so images and videos in storage buckets remain.
notes: Storage cleanup elsewhere not searched exhaustively; this is for the delete route only.

title: Location view delete also removes the image object in shared storage (wave1 claim)
summary: Deleting a location view removes its image object from the shared asset-images bucket while frames rows may still reference its URL. Shots referencing the view have camera_direction_id set to null.
notes: wave1-unverified; FK SET NULL on camera_direction_id re-verified by migration grep.
side_effects: storage object removed; DB cascade SET NULL on shots

title: Phase A unlock impact dialog cannot show: response shape mismatch
summary: The backend 409 nests downstreamStages under details, but the Phase A client returns the raw body and ProjectView reads result.downstreamStages at the top level. The else branch then auto-confirms the unlock, so the Phase A warning is never shown. Phase B unwraps details correctly.
notes: Contradicts wave1 which described the UI as auto-confirming without stating that the dialog was designed but unreachable.
ui_signal: toast Stage n unlocked for editing with no dialog

title: frames.status 'invalidated' violates the frames CHECK constraint
summary: frames.status accepts only pending, generating, generated, approved and rejected. shots/unlock writes 'invalidated' to frames, so the statement fails. The error is not checked. The code comment says frames are marked invalidated (not deleted).
notes: scene unlock filters frames with neq status invalidated (no effect since value never persists).

title: The videos table is referenced by runtime code but no migration creates it
summary: shots/unlock and stage-locks unlock query and update a videos table. No CREATE TABLE videos appears in backend/migrations. The same name is used as a storage bucket by Veo3Provider, which is a different API. Counts are always zero and updates silently fail.
notes: Video rows are actually in video_generation_jobs. Whether a database outside migrations has a videos table is UNKNOWN (wave1 noted prod was patched via quickies scripts).

title: scenes.status values frames_locked, outdated and continuity_broken have no writer
summary: The scenes status CHECK and TypeScript unions include frames_locked, outdated and continuity_broken, and UI labels map frames_locked. No backend or frontend code writes these values; only draft, shot_list_ready and video_complete are written.
notes: Existing production rows may hold such values (UNKNOWN).
ui_signal: Frames Ready label reachable only via existing rows

title: scenes.stage_locks column is defined only by a manual quickies script
summary: The JSONB column scenes.stage_locks used by every Phase B lock route is created in backend/quickies-sql/add_stage_locks.sql, a manual script noted as run on prod. No numbered migration creates or alters it.
notes: A database built only from numbered migrations would lack this column. This is a cross-check against C-database.

title: Stage 5 style change leaves the stage 5 row locked and clears style keys through autosave
summary: Change Style handlers call asset routes and set local style state to null, which triggers the Stage 5 autosave and writes a draft row that the guard keeps locked. No unlock call is made, so the Phase A stage remains locked with content lacking the style keys.
notes: Whether this is intended is UNKNOWN (no code comment establishes intent beyond unlock being local). Runtime not executed.
trigger: Change Style then Mark Outdated or Clear All Images
side_effects: stage 5 content keys cleared; locked row replaced
ui_signal: Locked badge remains; Change Style button

title: Stage 4 approve and Stage 5 finalize are two-request sequences with no rollback
summary: Stage 4 approve persists scenes then locks stage 4, and Stage 5 finalize locks all assets then locks stage 5. Each pair is separate HTTP calls; a failure in the second leaves the first committed.
notes: Stage 5 finalize has no compensating write on failure (toast only).

title: Opening Stage 4 writes a version because TipTap setContent emits update by default
summary: Stage 4 hydrates the editor with setContent. TipTap 3.15.3 defaults emitUpdate to true, so onUpdate fires and schedules a 2 s draft save, creating a new stage_states version on each open.
notes: Code-level; the editor effect guards on JSON equality, so the write happens when editor and stored content differ (typically on first hydrate).

title: Stage 8 manual asset creation writes project_assets.locked = true
summary: create-with-project-asset inserts a project asset with locked true, so assets created in Stage 8 are locked from creation. The wave1 summary listed only lock-all and POST lock as writers.
notes: Consequence for Stage 8 editing of those assets' text not separately traced.

title: invalidation_logs table is written but never created
summary: shots/unlock inserts into invalidation_logs inside a try block. No migration creates that table, and Supabase errors are returned rather than thrown, so the write is silently dropped.
notes: Only one reference found in backend and src.

title: text_field_versions lacks FK cascade and has permissive RLS
summary: entity_id has no FK, so shot and instance deletes leave orphaned version rows. The table policy is FOR ALL USING (true) with WITH CHECK (true).
notes: Effect of RLS depends on the connection role (UNKNOWN from code).

title: GET /api/projects/:id currentStage counts every stage_states version
summary: The by-id route selects all stage_states rows for the branch without deduplication, so currentStage is the highest stage with any draft row in history. The list route deduplicates to latest rows.
notes: Frontend consumer of this field not identified; ProjectView keeps local currentStage.

title: Frame generation routes read stage_states.state_data by project_id (cross-slice)
summary: Five frame routes read state_data from stage_states filtered by project_id. Neither column exists, so the visualStyleCapsuleId passed to frame jobs is always undefined. Cross-reference to V2 and V9.
notes: Re-verified in this wave by reading the call sites.

title: Frame status endpoint that sets rejected and total cost has no UI caller
summary: Only GET frames/:id/status performs the completed and failed frame updates. Its client wrapper is used only by pollUntilComplete, which has no callers. Stage 10 polls the frames list instead, so frame job failures do not reach rejected from the UI. Repeated calls to the status endpoint would add job cost each time.
notes: Latent cost accumulation risk in onJobCompleted (no idempotence guard). Only triggered if the endpoint is called.

title: Video scene completion and manual retry behave as attempt-count and all-history checks
summary: video_complete requires every job for the scene to be completed across all renders, and retry keeps attempt_count so a retried job fails after a single attempt. Together, one historical failure blocks completion until it succeeds.
notes: Runtime not executed.
ui_signal: scene not complete; retry fails quickly

title: Asset and shot extraction insert without checking existing rows (backend)
summary: POST assets/extract-confirm and POST shots/extract insert new rows with no backend check for existing names or existing shots. Shot extraction is auto-invoked on Stage 7 mount only when a scene has zero shots; asset extraction gating in the UI was not traced.
notes: Duplicate creation possible if called twice; UI gating for asset extraction UNKNOWN.

title: Scene unlock and shot-list unlock cost estimates use fixed constants
summary: Both unlock assessments estimate regeneration cost as frames times 0.05 plus videos times 2.50, hard-coded in the route. Values are shown in the dialog only.
notes: Line for sceneStageLocks approximate.

title: Stage 1 mode and config UI is hidden when locked; Streamline commit reachability on locked projects is UNKNOWN
summary: Stage 1 hides the locked-state config section and the non-streamline Proceed button when stage 1 is locked or outdated. Whether the Streamline review screen and its commit remain reachable while stage 1..5 are locked was not established.
notes: Settles only by checking StreamlineReviewScreen entry conditions or runtime.
